TITLE: Spectrum Bars
DESCRIPTION: Internal renderer-test archetype: a classic 8-bar vertical spectrum analyzer driven by chroma_AudioFFT[0..7]. Each bar maps one log-spaced FFT band; bar height tracks the band magnitude, overall brightness tracks chroma_AudioRMS/chroma_AudioPeak, and a syn_BPM-phased pulse plus TIME shimmer keep the image alive at silence. Exercises the full chroma_AudioFFT[8] FloatArray binding and RENDERSIZE. Not shipped in the bundled library.
